title: Captain Girard
description: As a seasoned veteran of the Galactic Civil War that brought an end to the evil Empire, Captain Girard commanded her own ship in the New Republic Defense Fleet called the Dawnbringer. She led a small fleet of ships to Seatos to find General Hera Syndulla and Ahsoka Tano after they embarked on an unsanctioned mission to stop Morgan Elsbeth from finding Grand Admiral Thrawn.
